answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 67548 Country: France Title: What is the Shariah ruling if someone cancels his fasts of Ramadan due to disease? Question: I canceled my fast thrice this month of Ramadan because of disease. I feared the worsening of my condition and fear was experimental (the same day my illness worsened gradually, either in the past I had experienced ). So do I have to do expiation and taubah as per the Hanafi school because of this or not? Answer ID: 67548 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1077/1103/N=10/1437) If you didn’t keep three fasts of Ramadan in the beginning i.e. you didn’t break them after starting, then only their qaza is wajib on you, not kaffarah (expiration). As kaffarah does not become wajib only due to leaving the fast of Ramadan rather it becomes wajib due to breaking it without a Shari’ah reason after observing. However, if, on the basis of your previous experience of increasing the illness, you did not keep the fast then you shall have to bear no sin, in-shaAllah. So it is mentioned in the books of Fiqh and Fatawa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
